notes: Uses the EXACT combat1/2/3 paramN mapping from the supplied formulaAuthoring.talentReferences packet, reading all 15 talent levels from the confirmed packaged data/characters/data/chasca.json. No copied or rounded inline talentParameters.

Every normal arrow and skill/burst shell formula represents ONE hit. Normal hit 3 fires 2 arrows and normal hit 4 fires 3; the per-arrow entries are NOT combined totals. Low/high plunge impact alternatives are mutually exclusive.

Shadowhunt and Radiant Soulseeker formulas are per-hit damage CLASS alternatives, not six simultaneous elemental slot outputs. For a full Skill salvo at C0, shell 1 and 2 are ordinary Anemo; shell 3 converts with A1 chance; shells 4-6 convert one per qualifying Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo teammate. At C1, shell 2 additionally converts when the A1 proc occurs. Shells fire last-in-first-out.

The converter lists one ordinary Anemo shell and one Shining shell per eligible element; the chosen element is randomized by the game. Each converted formula is gated by the selected-team presence of that element. No independent projectile selectors or slot-level random sampling are implemented. Do NOT add all alternative formula outputs as though every element hits simultaneously.

A1 unique eligible element count is derived by summing min(1,team elemental count) for Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo, not by total teammates, so duplicate elements do not inflate it. Its 0/15/35/65% bonus is additive in the ordinary damage bonus bucket only for Shining Shadowhunt Shells, not ordinary Anemo shells, Burst, Burning Shot or C2/C4 AoE.

C2 adds one Radiant Shadow stack (maximum 3); its higher-priority stacking effect REPLACES the C0 A1 damage-bonus effect rather than stacking both. The C1 extra conversion chance only changes which of the representative converted shells may occur.

For Burst, the opening Galesplitting hit is Anemo and the six follow-up shells contain two converted hits per Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo teammate, up to six in total; other hits are Anemo. Element order is random. Converted Radiant shells deal Burst damage; C4 extra AoE is Charged Attack damage.

A4 Burning Shot appears only if burningShotElement is manually selected after a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst. Use 1 Anemo only with NO eligible elements, or values 2..5 for a present Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo teammate. It deals 150% of the BASE Skill-shell talent multiplier (combat2 param3/4); it does not automatically inherit A1 Shining-shell bonus.

C2 and C4 extra AoE have local element selectors, 0=not triggered, 1=Pyro, 2=Hydro, 3=Electro, 4=Cryo. They represent ONE 400%-ATK hit per eligible Skill salvo/Burst, respectively. The selected element must match a landed Shining/Radiant shell; party-presence conditions reject impossible elements, but the calculator cannot verify the triggering shell or number of enemies hit.

C6 Fatal Rounds is a MANUAL 0/1 state and adds 120 percentage points of CRIT DMG only to the Skill Multitarget Fire shells; does not apply to A4, Skill tap/activation, C2 AoE, C4 AoE or Burst. The trigger, 3-second duration, cooldown and charge speed are not simulated.
C3 and C5 add exactly 3 to Skill/Burst talent levels (capped at 15); provide base, not constellation-preincreased, talent levels as calculator inputs to avoid double counting.

Mounted Nightsoul plunge uses Normal Attack plunge multipliers; its rows are alternatives to the ordinary plunge rows and should never be summed with the same physical plunge. An ordinary Anemo Shining conversion is not an external infusion, therefore converted hits have infusionRule locked.
For a solo Chasca, the team has no eligible Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo teammate, so no Shining Shell, converted Burning Shot, Radiant Burst Shell, C2 or C4 converted AoE formula is active.

The calculator does not model projectile order and reaction ICD, enemy aura, number of targets, chance of shell conversion, projectile firing count, resource depletion, movement, rotation DPS or snapshot timings. Its ordinary reaction previews are per hit, not an automatically valid multi-shell reaction sequence.

The C1 out-of-combat Nightsoul/Phlogiston consumption reduction, Nightsoul point recovery, passive exploration buffs and C4 Energy restoration are informational, not outgoing damage modifiers. Chasca has no verified Hexerei or Moonsign contribution.
